meta.title: Religious practice
meta.question: How often do Poles go to church?
meta.measure: Average frequency of attending religious services, from 0 (never) to 10 (more than once a week)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on how often people attend religious services, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: Do you take part in religious practices such as Mass, services or religious meetings? (several times a week, once a week, several times a year, not at all)
items.notes: CBOS, 1990-03 and 1992-03 to 1996-10 (51 surveys). Four-point version without the monthly category; the 1990-03 survey asks the same frequencies in a slightly different wording ("never" at the bottom). Uneven spacing: the gap between "once a week" and "several times a year" is large.

items.wording: Apart from weddings, funerals and christenings, how often do you attend religious services these days? (more than once a week, once a week, once a month, Christmas/Easter, other holy days, once a year, less often, practically never)
items.notes: EVS 1990 and 1999. The two holy-day categories make the scale uneven.

items.wording: How would you describe your attitude to faith and religious practice? Believer practising regularly (10), believer practising irregularly (5), believer not practising (0)
items.notes: CBOS, 1990-09 to 1992-01 (14 surveys), the only CBOS practice series for those months. Codes 4 (non-believer who goes to church, under 1%) and 5 (non-believer, non-practising, 2-3%) are left without a position because the pipeline allows only one code at 0; this nudges the level up slightly but not the trend. Mixes belief and practice; practice is the part that varies.

items.wording: When did you last attend Sunday Mass? (last Sunday, within the last month, more than a month ago, cannot remember when, I do not go to church)
items.notes: CBOS, 1990-09 and 1991-03 (2 surveys). "Cannot remember when" is placed between "more than a month ago" and "do not go".

items.wording: Religion - church attendance (several times a week, once a week, several/a few times a year, once a year (or less), never)
items.notes: CEEB 2 (1991) and 3 (1992). Waves 1 and 4 have attendance variables but they are empty for Poland; the label check keeps V351/V413 of other waves out.

items.wording: How often do you attend Mass or religious services? (never ... several times a week or more often, 9 categories)
How often do you take part in religious practices such as Mass, services or religious meetings? (more than once a week, once a week, 1-3 times a month, several times a year, less often, never)
items.notes: CBOS, May 1994: a six-point version of the attendance question.

items.wording: Do you take part in religious practices such as Mass, services or religious meetings? (several times a week, once a week, once or twice a month, several times a year, not at all)
items.notes: CBOS, 1996-11 to 2017-12, the standard metryczka question (248 surveys). Categories are uneven in frequency terms but ordered; coded linearly.

items.wording: How often do you attend religious services? (more than once a week ... never, practically never)
items.notes: WVS 1997, 2005, 2012 (1989 Poland file has no attendance question).

items.wording: How often do you attend religious services? (never ... several times a week, 8 categories)
items.notes: PGSW 1997-2015 (6 surveys). The harmonised 6-category relig_attend is not used: its 2019 and 2023 values come from a different question (weekly attendance falls from 46% to 25% between 2015 and 2019 in the source data), see the notes.

items.wording: How often do you attend church / Mass / religious services and meetings? (never, once a month or less, between monthly and weekly, about once a week, more than once a week)
items.notes: POLPAN 1998, 2003, 2013, 2018 (panel with refreshment samples). Same five categories; the noun varies (church attendance, Mass, religious services and meetings). In 2013 the regex takes P09 (whole sample) and not the duplicate P23 of the supplementary questionnaire.

items.wording: Religious practices (a few times a week, once a week, once or twice a month, a few times a year, never)
items.notes: PGSW 2000 presidential study (single survey).

items.wording: Apart from special occasions, how often do you attend religious services nowadays? (every day ... never)
items.notes: ESS rounds 1-11 (2002-2024). Round 10 was self-completion (the pipeline splits it).

items.wording: Attendance at religious services (several times a week, once a week, a few times a year, once a year or less, never)
items.notes: EES 2004 (Poland). Very uneven: no monthly category.

items.wording: How often do you attend Mass? (never, once a month or less, between monthly and weekly, about once a week or more)
items.notes: POLPAN 2008 only: the top two categories are merged.

items.wording: How often do you attend religious services? (more than once a week, once a week, once a month, only on specific holy days, once a year, less often, never)
items.notes: EVS 2008 and 2017. The "attended at 12 years old" question is excluded by the anchored regex.

items.wording: Aside from weddings and funerals, how often do you attend religious services? (more than once a week, once a week, once or twice a month, a few times a year, seldom, never)
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2009 (spring and fall), 2010-2013 (6 surveys).

items.wording: Attendance at religious services (several times a week, once a week, at least once a month, a few times a year, once a year or less, never)
items.notes: EES 2009 (Poland).

items.wording: Apart from weddings or funerals, about how often do you attend religious services? (more than once a week ... never)
items.notes: EES 2014 (Poland). The regex is anchored on D75 on purpose: EES 2019's D10 has the same wording but was not asked of respondents with no denomination (14% of the Polish sample coded 96), so it is left out.

items.wording: Apart from weddings and funerals, how often do you currently take part in Mass, services or religious meetings? (every day ... never)
items.notes: SWPS COVID tracker waves 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 (April-June 2020), online. "Currently" during the spring 2020 limits on church attendance: weekly attendance rises from 16% to 26% across these waves, partly the reopening of churches.

items.wording: Do you take part in religious practices such as Mass or services? (CBOS five categories)
items.notes: CBOS democracy survey, about 2021 (single survey; mixed mode, so kept apart from the CBOS monthly item).

items.wording: How often do you attend Mass and services? (never, once a year, 2-11 times a year, once a month, two or more times a month, once a week or more)
items.notes: SWPS COVID tracker waves 14 and 15 (July and November 2021), online; the PGSW six-category scheme.

items.wording: Apart from special occasions, how often do you attend religious services nowadays? (every day ... never)
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Attendance at religious services (every day, more than once a week, once a week, once or twice a month, a few times a year, less often, never)
items.notes: Pew 2024 spring (single survey).

items.wording: Apart from weddings and funerals, how often do you attend religious services? (more than once a week ... never)
items.notes: EES 2024 voter study (online); asked of everyone.

items.wording: Apart from weddings and funerals, how often do you currently take part in Mass, services or religious meetings? (every day ... never)
items.notes: FNW SWPS surveys May 2025, Dec 2025, May 2026 (online).

items.wording: How often do you take part in religious practices? (not at all, several times a year, once or twice a month, once a week, several times a week)
items.notes: PGSW 2025 presidential study; the CBOS five-category scheme.
